name: cinemetric
description: Cinemetric: Claude skills for your Plex server. Read-only reports on your media and server.

plugins.name: cinemetric
plugins.description: Read-only reports on your Plex Media Server: library stats and housekeeping, server health and live streams, watch activity (with optional Tautulli), who your server is shared with, a dashboard page that pulls the main stats together, and mods for Claude Code (a read-only guard that stops Claude from changing your server, and a library status line), for Linux, macOS and Windows.
